text:
Priya (Product): thanks everyone for coming — quick follow-up from today's all‑hands. a few folks asked for clearer timelines on API streaming improvements, per-route dashboards in the Console, and Optimize's auto-quantization recommendations. can leadership/eng share short targets so teams can plan? :sparkles:

Alex (CTO): short version: streaming perf work (lower p95 & better backpressure) aiming for an internal beta by end of July, public beta mid-August. priority/latency lanes (scheduling + routing changes) targeted for early Q3 pilot, GA depending on pilot feedback. per-route dashboards will be phased: hosted console beta in Aug, Dedicated support in Q4. Optimize auto-quant (recommendation engine) experimental in Q3, GA later Q4. i'll post a concise timeline doc later today. :calendar:

Sam (PM): adding a couple datapoints: streaming milestone is specifically the KV cache + batching improvements — goal is ~25% p95 improvement for typical chat workloads. priority lanes feature will let customers pin routes to a low-latency pool and configure fallback policies. early pilot customers available — ping me if you want access.

Jordan (Eng): implementation note — priority lanes requires scheduler + autoscaler changes and a rethink of eviction policies for cached prefixes. we have a spike in progress but there are infra risks (node churn tests) that could slip the pilot by a couple weeks if we hit scale regressions. we'll surface blockers in eng-runtime channel.

Priya (Product): re: Console per-route metrics — the beta will include token cost breakdown, p50/p95 latency, and a miniature traces view. not GA until we validate on production traffic across hosted and Dedicated.

Elena (Support): how are we communicating deprecations / migrations for customers when we flip on new routing or streaming modes? we need runbooks.

Priya (Product): good point — plan is: console migration flags, 30/60 day deprecation windows, automatic SDK warnings, and a one‑click rollback in the Console for route-level changes. we'll coordinate with support + solutions for customer comms.

Sam (PM): example rollout flag for internal testing: ```json
{
  "optimize_auto_quant": "beta",
  "priority_lane_enabled": false,
  "streaming_mode": "improved-backpressure"
}
```

Kai (CEO): high-level reminder: prioritize reliability and predictable rollbacks. any feature that affects latency SLAs for Dedicated customers should have a canary + automatic fallback to the current behavior.

Alex (CTO): agree. I'll ensure the infra team adds a conservative fallback policy by default. if anyone wants the timeline doc earlier, DM me — i'll drop it here when done. :+1:

Priya (Product): thanks — i'll put a short FAQ in the Console roadmap card and link to the doc once Alex posts it. follow-ups welcome in this thread or ping @Sam/@Jordan for technical details. :raised_hands:
